shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ && cat AGENTS.md

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -C 3 'dashboard\|dashkit\|grid' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo ---- && ls src && cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && ls __agent_eval__

npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -40; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@^10 2>&1 | tail -5 && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null | head -30

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm | head -30; echo ---- README; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; echo ---- DTS; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo ---- PLUGIN TYPES; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---- STYLES; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build -name '*.css' | head; grep -rn "styles\|\.css" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -10

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ---- CSS IMPORT; grep -rn "\.css" $D/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js $D/components/GridItem/GridItem.js | head -5; echo ---- COMPONENTS INDEX; cat $D/components/index.d.ts; echo ---- DASHKIT PROPS; cat $D/components/DashKit.d.ts; echo ---- SHARED TYPES; cat $D/shared/types/config.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; echo ---- COMMON; cat $D/typings/common.d.ts | head -120

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ---- DASHKIT; cat $D/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; echo ---- ACTIONPANEL; cat $D/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; echo ---- DND; cat $D/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; echo ---- OVERLAY; sed -n 1,60p $D/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts; echo ---- CONSTS; cat $D/constants/common.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---- PLUGINS; cat $D/plugins/index.d.ts; cat $D/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts; cat $D/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts; echo ---- UIKIT CARD/TEXT; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/ | grep -i 'card\|text\.\|button\|switch\|label\|progress\|flex\|icon' ; echo ---- ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE '^(Plus|TrashBin|Pencil|ChartColumn|ChartLine|ArrowsRotate|Check|Gear|Xmark|TextAlignLeft|Heading|ListUl|Clock|Gauge|CircleCheck|Server|Cpu|Font|Database|Persons|Rocket|LayoutCells|Grip|LockOpen|Lock|FloppyDisk|ArrowRotateLeft)\.d\.ts$'

S=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/6e21f4e8bf3440b17006b2ce5945144b/dataviz; grep -n -i -A6 'hero number\|stat tile' $S/references/choosing-a-form.md | head -60; echo ---- MARKS; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 '^#.*hero' $S/references/marks-and-anatomy.md | head -70; echo ---- ANTI; grep -n '^- \*\*\|^## \|^### ' $S/references/anti-patterns.md | head -50

S=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/6e21f4e8bf3440b17006b2ce5945144b/dataviz; sed -n 48,105p $S/references/anti-patterns.md; echo ---- STAT TILE SPEC; grep -n -i -B1 -A10 'stat tile\|hero figure\|meter' $S/references/marks-and-anatomy.md | head -90; echo ---- INTERACTION filters; grep -n -i -A4 'filters in one row\|time range' $S/references/interaction.md | head -30

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ---- CHARTS; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -12; echo ---- CARD; grep -n "view\|type\|theme\|size\|selected\|disabled\|onClick" $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; echo ---- TEXT; grep -n "variant\|color\|ellipsis\|whiteSpace" $U/Text/Text.d.ts | head; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|TEXT_COLORS" -A 25 $U/Text/constants.d.ts | head -50; echo ---- LABEL; grep -n "theme\|size\|value" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head; echo ---- PROGRESS; grep -n "value\|theme\|size\|text\|loading" $U/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -14; echo ---- SWITCH; sed -n 1,20p $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|content\|size" $U/Controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---- FLEX; grep -n "direction\|gap\|alignItems\|justifyContent\|grow\|wrap\|width" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -14; echo ---- BUTTON; grep -n "view\|size\|selected\|disabled" $U/Button/Button.d.ts | head -12; echo ---- TABLE; grep -n "columns\|data\|getRowId\|verticalAlign\|width\|emptyMessage" $U/Table/Table.d.ts | head -20; echo ---- DASHKIT DND TYPES; cat $D/shared/types/dnd.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "ItemDragProps\|ItemDropProps" -A8 $D/shared/types/*.d.ts | head -50; echo ---- TITLE; cat $D/plugins/Title/types.d.ts; echo ---- UIKIT index exports check; grep -o "Card\|Progress\|Label\|Switch\|Flex\|Table\|Text\|Button\|Icon\|Tooltip\|Divider\|Toaster\|useToaster" $U/index.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo ---- CHARTS v1; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -14; echo ---- PROGRESS; cat $U/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -40; echo ---- TEXT VARIANTS; grep -rn "header-1" $U/Text/*.d.ts $U/Text/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "TextColor\b\|TEXT_COLORS" $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -5; sed -n 1,30p $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts; echo ---- CONTROLPROPS; grep -n -A14 "interface ControlProps" $U/types.d.ts; echo ---- TABLE COL; sed -n 15,50p $U/Table/Table.d.ts

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1 2>&1 | grep -v "allow-scripts" | tail -3; C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts; grep '"version"' $C/package.json; ls $C; ls $C/build 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---- DOCS; f=$(ls $C/build/docs/INDEX.md $C/dist/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; [ -n "$f" ] && sed -n 1,80p $f; echo ---- README setup; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "## Usage\|## Install\|styles\|Required setup" $C/README.md | head -80; echo ---- PROGRESS TYPES; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -60

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist; ls $C | head; echo ---- ChartProps; find $C -name "Chart.d.ts" -o -name "index.d.ts" -path "*components*" | head -3; grep -rn "export interface ChartProps" -A 20 $C/components/Chart/index.d.ts $C/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---- ChartData; grep -n "export type ChartData\|export interface ChartData" -A 30 $C/types/chart/chart.d.ts $C/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---- BARX; f=$(grep -rl "BarXSeriesData" $C/types | head -3); echo $f; grep -n "BarXSeriesData\b" -A 25 $C/types/chart/bar-x.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -70; echo ---- XAXIS; grep -n "categories\|type?: ChartAxisType\|export type ChartAxisType" $C/types/chart/axis.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---- GETSTARTED; sed -n 1,80p $C/docs/get-started.md | grep -n -A12 "bar-x\|categories" | head -40

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; ls $C; ls $C/types 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---- ChartProps; grep -rn "export type ChartProps\|export interface ChartProps" -A 20 $C/components/Chart/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -35; echo ---- ChartData; grep -rn "export interface ChartData\b\|export type ChartData\b" -A 25 $C/types 2>/dev/null | head -45; echo ---- BARX; grep -rn "export type BarXSeriesData\|export interface BarXSeriesData" -A 30 $C/types 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -rn "export interface BarXSeries\b" -A 30 $C/types 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo ---- AXIS; grep -rn "categories\|type?: ChartAxisType\|export type ChartAxisType" $C/types 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo ---- DOCS get-started; grep -n -B3 -A14 "bar-x" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md | head -60

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; echo ---- INDEX; cat $C/index.d.ts; echo ---- COMPONENTS; cat $C/components/index.d.ts; ls $C/components; echo ---- CHART CMP; cat $C/components/Chart/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p $C/components/Chart/Chart.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---- CORE TYPES; ls $C/core 2>/dev/null; ls $C/core/types 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---- GET STARTED; sed -n 1,120p node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; ls $T/chart $T/series 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---- CHARTDATA; grep -rn "export interface ChartData\b\|export interface ChartData<" -A 30 $T | head -50; echo ---- BARX; grep -rn "export interface BarXSeriesData\b\|export interface BarXSeries\b" -A 28 $T | head -90; echo ---- AXIS; grep -rn "categories?\|type?: ChartAxisType\|export type ChartAxisType\|export interface ChartAxis\b" $T | head -8; grep -rn "export interface ChartAxis\b" -A 14 $T | head -40; echo ---- LEGEND/TOOLTIP enabled; grep -rn "enabled?: boolean" $T | head -8; echo ---- SERIES OPTIONS color; grep -rn "color?: string" $T/series/*.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "borderRadius\|dataLabels" $T/series/bar-x.d.ts | head

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; sed -n 71,110p $T/index.d.ts; echo ---- LEGEND; grep -n "enabled\|export interface ChartLegend\b" $T/chart/legend.d.ts | head -5; echo ---- BARX RADIUS; sed -n 75,90p $T/chart/bar-x.d.ts; echo ---- CHART OPTIONS; grep -n "margin\|export interface ChartOptions\|export interface ChartMargin" -A4 $T/chart/chart.d.ts | head -40; echo ---- TOOLTIP; grep -n "export interface ChartTooltip\b" -A 12 $T/chart/tooltip.d.ts | grep -n "enabled" ; echo ---- AXIS labels/grid; grep -n "grid?\|visible?: boolean\|export interface ChartAxisLabels" $T/chart/axis.d.ts | head -12

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ---- GRID DEFAULTS; grep -rn "cols\|rowHeight\|margin" $D/constants/*.js $D/utils/register-manager.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo ---- TEXT PLUGIN markdown; grep -n "withMarkdown\|dangerouslySetInnerHTML\|renderText" -A3 $D/plugins/Text/Text.js | head -30; echo ---- UIKIT configure; grep -n "configure\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts | head; echo ---- DASHKIT i18n keys ru; ls $D/i18n; grep -rn "ru" $D/i18n/index.js | head -3

grep -rn "export declare const configure\|export declare enum Lang\|export declare const Lang" -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -14; grep -n "configure\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -4

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -rln "configure" $U/*.d.ts $U/components/utils/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "export declare function configure\|export declare const configure\|Lang" -A3 $(grep -rln "function configure\|const configure" $U --include=*.d.ts | head -2) | head -20

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -iE '^(Hashtag|Number|Gauge|Speed|Thermometer|BarsAscending|Pulse|Percent|ChartAreaStacked|ChartBar|CircleDollar|Abbr|Target|Hash|Layers|Sliders)' ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -iE 'Bars|Chart|Percent|Pulse|Thermo|Hash' | grep -v '\.js\|\.d\.ts' | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "MenuItems\|export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/constants/index.d.ts | head

sed -i "s/import {ActionPanel, DashKit, DashKitDnDWrapper, MenuItems} from '@gravity-ui\/dashkit';/import {ActionPanel, DashKit, DashKitDnDWrapper} from '@gravity-ui\/dashkit';/; s/import type {ActionPanelItem, DashKitProps, ItemDropProps} from '@gravity-ui\/dashkit';/import type {ActionPanelItem, DashKitProps, ItemDropProps, MenuItem} from '@gravity-ui\/dashkit';/; s/import {ArrowRotateLeft, ChartColumn, Font, Gauge, Heading, LayoutCells, Numbers} from '@gravity-ui\/icons';/import {ArrowRotateLeft, ChartColumn, Font, Hashtag, Heading, LayoutCells, Speedometer} from '@gravity-ui\/icons';/; s/icon: Numbers}/icon: Hashtag}/; s/icon: Gauge}/icon: Speedometer}/; s/const overlayMenuItems = useMemo(() => \[MenuItems.Delete\], \[\]);/const overlayMenuItems = useMemo<MenuItem[]>(() => ['delete'], []);/" src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx && grep -n "MenuItem\|Hashtag\|Speedometer" src/dashboard/Dashboard.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 && echo TSC_DONE && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ---- PLUGIN ROOT ATTR; grep -rn "PLUGIN_ROOT_ATTR_NAME =" $D/constants/ $D/plugins/ 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---- editMode class; grep -o "dashkit-grid-item_editMode\|dashkit-grid-item_edit-mode\|cursor: move" $D/components/GridItem/GridItem.css $D/components/GridItem/GridItem.js | sort -u | head; echo ---- plugin container wrapper; grep -o "dashkit-plugin-container__wrapper" $D/components/Item/Item.js $D/components/Item/Item.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u; grep -n "height" $D/components/Item/Item.css | head -5; echo ---- jsdom; ls node_modules | grep -iE '^(jsdom|happy-dom)$'; rm -rf dist; git status --short | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/components/Item/Item.css; echo ----; grep -n "dashkit-grid-item__item\|height" $D/components/GridItem/GridItem.css | head; echo ----; cat $D/plugins/Text/Text.css | head -20

sed -i '40,49d' src/dashboard/Dashboard.css && sed -i "40i\\
/*\\
 * Built-in text plugin: give it the same card surface as custom widgets.\\
 * Hooks on the public \`data-plugin-root-el\` attribute exported by dashkit\\
 * (PLUGIN_ROOT_ATTR_NAME), pinned to @gravity-ui/dashkit 10.5.x.\\
 */\\
.dashboard__grid [data-plugin-root-el='text'] {" src/dashboard/Dashboard.css && sed -n 30,60p src/dashboard/Dashboard.css && npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|✓ built"; rm -rf dist

sed -i 's/^\.dashboard__grid \.dashkit-grid-item {$/.dashboard__grid {\n    \/* DashKit CSS API (documented in its README) *\//' src/dashboard/Dashboard.css && sed -n 22,38p src/dashboard/Dashboard.css && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK
